headline: Tanya Halina Advani Files SEBI Regulation 31(4) Disclosure for Substantial Acquisition in Ador Welding Limited
sum: Tanya Halina Advani has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE relating to a substantial acquisition of shares or takeover-related transaction in Ador Welding Limited; exact shareholding threshold, consideration and structure contained in the filed disclosure document.
implication: Reg 31(4) filing triggers public disclosure obligations and may signal intent to acquire control or board influence; counsel should review trigger thresholds (typically 5% for listed companies) and mandatory open offer requirements under Reg 38 if applicable.
detail: Tanya Halina Advani submitted a formal SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on or around 19 June 2026. This regulation mandates disclosure when a party acquires shares representing a substantial stake or when a takeover-related transaction is initiated. The specific shareholding percentage acquired, consideration amount, and transaction structure are documented in the filed disclosure but have not been independently corroborated in public sources.
